h=1 gives terminal parity equality; h=2 gives equality of rho2=e_last-2*(e_prev mod2) mod6.
Every odd-orbit prefix exponent sum S_t <= t*log2(3+1/R#).
Entry rotation prefix excess is bounded by preperiod slack beta_R*k-B.
Xi-height constraints on successors of odd cycle exponents yield a strict analytic sharpening of the cycle slope upper bound.
